/.title: TroyStack: live gold and silver prices, with Troy
/.description: Track every coin and bar at today's spot, and ask Troy what moved the market. Free, no account needed to start.

/troy.title: Ask Troy, the analyst for gold and silver stackers
/troy.description: Ask Troy what moved gold and silver today, what a coin is worth, or how your stack is doing. Three free questions a day.

/stack.title: My stack
/stack.description: Your gold, silver, platinum and palladium at live spot, with cost basis and gain. Free, and it syncs with the TroyStack app.

/signal.title: The Signal: gold and silver news with Troy's read
/signal.description: Troy reads the precious metals news all day and writes what each story means for people who hold physical gold and silver.

/podcast.title: The Stack Signal podcast: a daily gold and silver brief
/podcast.description: Troy's morning brief on gold and silver, a few minutes long, every day. Listen here or on Apple Podcasts.

/vault.title: COMEX Vault Watch: registered and eligible gold and silver
/vault.description: Daily COMEX warehouse stocks for gold, silver, platinum and palladium: registered metal ready for delivery, eligible metal in storage, and the day's change.

/tools.title: Precious metals calculators and tools
/tools.description: Free melt value and junk silver calculators, a what-if tool for your stack, monthly stacking history since 1970, and the gold/silver ratio.

/tools/melt.title: Melt value calculator for gold and silver coins
/tools/melt.description: Work out the melt value of any gold, silver, platinum or palladium coin, round or bar at live spot, including pre-1933 US gold and pre-1965 silver.

/tools/junk-silver.title: Junk Silver Melt Value Calculator: Pre-1965 Coins
/tools/junk-silver.description: Melt value of 90% silver dimes, quarters and halves by face value at live spot, using 0.7234 oz per $1 face (as struck) or 0.715 (circulated).

/tools/what-if.title: What if gold or silver hit your number
/tools/what-if.description: Pick a price for gold, silver, platinum and palladium and see what your stack, or any amount of metal, would be worth.

/tools/stacking-history.title: Stacking history: monthly gold and silver buying since 1970
/tools/stacking-history.description: See what buying a set dollar amount of gold or silver every month from any year since 1970 would be worth today, at spot or with a dealer premium.

/tools/ratio.title: Gold to silver ratio today, with history
/tools/ratio.description: How many ounces of silver one ounce of gold buys at live spot, with the ratio charted over one year, five years and back to 1915.

/calculator.title: What does your gold and silver actually buy?
/calculator.description: Enter your gold and silver and see what it buys at live spot in barrels of oil, months of rent and hours of labor, and how that compares to 1971.

/speculation.title: Gold and silver price what-if calculator
/speculation.description: Enter your gold and silver, set target prices, and see what your stack could be worth and what it would buy, against live spot.

/coins.title: Coin and bar melt values at live spot
/coins.description: Melt value for Silver Eagles, Maple Leafs, Krugerrands, Morgan dollars, junk silver, old US gold and common bars, with each one's weight and purity.

/dealers.title: Where to buy gold and silver online
/dealers.description: Bullion dealers TroyStack links to, and what to compare before you order: premium per ounce, payment method, shipping and buyback.

/app.title: TroyStack for iPhone
/app.description: Track your gold and silver at live spot, set price alerts, scan dealer receipts, and talk to Troy. Free to download, with a free week of Gold.

/gold.title: TroyStack Gold: plans and the free week
/gold.description: Gold gives you 30 questions a day with Troy, a morning brief around your stack and unlimited receipt scans. $4.99 a month or $39.99 a year after a free week, or $99.99 once.

/delete-account.title: Delete your TroyStack account
/delete-account.description: How to delete your TroyStack account and what it holds, what's kept, and what happens to an App Store, Google Play or web subscription.

/privacy.title: Privacy Policy
/privacy.description: What TroyStack collects, who it is shared with, and how to delete your account. Mancini Tech Solutions, LLC.

/terms.title: Terms of Service
/terms.description: Terms for TroyStack, including TroyStack Gold at $4.99 a month, $39.99 a year, or $99.99 once. Mancini Tech Solutions, LLC.

/developers.title: TroyStack API and MCP server for precious metals data
/developers.description: Live gold and silver prices, history, COMEX vault data and Stack Signal stories, over a REST API or an MCP server you can add to Claude or Cursor.

/prices/gold.title: Gold price today per ounce, gram and karat
/prices/gold.description: Live gold spot price per troy ounce, gram and kilo, with 24k to 10k gold per gram and charts from 24 hours back to the long-run history.

/prices/silver.title: Silver price today per ounce and gram
/prices/silver.description: Live silver spot price per troy ounce, gram and kilo, with sterling and coin silver per gram and charts from 24 hours back to the long-run history.

/prices/platinum.title: Platinum price today, live spot and charts
/prices/platinum.description: Live platinum spot price per troy ounce with today's move and charts from 24 hours back to the long-run history.

/prices/palladium.title: Palladium price today, live spot and charts
/prices/palladium.description: Live palladium spot price per troy ounce with today's move and charts from 24 hours back to the long-run history.
